entities.name: Central Asian Steppe
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: The vast grassland corridor stretching from Hungary to Manchuria that served as a highway for nomadic peoples, enabling the spread of horses, chariots, metallurgy, and empires across Eurasia. Scythians, Huns, Turks, and Mongols used steppe mobility to build empires that repeatedly reshaped sedentary civilizations from China to Europe.
